Demonstrating CSS Selectors

[Element Selector] This paragraph is styled using a standard element selector. It targets all standard paragraph tags globally unless overridden by a more specific selector.

[Class Selector] This paragraph uses a class selector (.highlight-box). Classes are reusable and can be applied to any HTML element on the page.

[ID Selector] This paragraph uses an ID selector (#unique-feature). IDs are strict and must be unique, meaning you should only use this specific ID once per page.

[Attribute Selector] This paragraph uses an attribute selector ([data-type="special"]). It targets elements based on the presence or value of a specific HTML attribute.
